run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only discovery run. External WebFetch/egress remained fully blocked by the organisation egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED, HTTP 403) again this run — reconfirmed with a live WebFetch call to https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm (EGRESS_BLOCKED). Proxy status endpoint reports healthy (enabled:true, bundleCoversEveryHost:true, recentRelayFailures empty); per /root/.ccr/README.md a 403 from the proxy is a non-retryable organisation egress-policy denial, so no tender detail page or specification document could be opened. Every opportunity below is therefore captured from WebSearch only: existence / ID / open-status from the verifiable result-link <title> text (e.g. 'Current ATM View - <ID>: AusTender', treated as reliable), and any buyer / title / date / scope detail from WebSearch answer snippets (which summarise the target page and are treated as SNIPPET-DERIVED, not independently verified — flagged in each entry's notes and detail_source). Tier 1 Commonwealth (AusTender) and all eight state/territory portals were probed via search (NSW buy.nsw, VIC Buying for Victoria / buyingfor.vic, QLD QTenders / supply.qld, WA Tenders WA, SA Tenders SA, TAS Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders). AusTender surfaced NEW buyer-originated Current-ATM notices not present in the routine's 510 known dedup keys: 26AMSA128 (AMSA MEOSAR ground segment RFI), GWEOS/RFI/99180/1 and its companion GWEOS/NOT/99180/1 (Defence CASG 5-inch naval ammunition load-assemble-pack), Pre-RFT Notice 68269 (Defence salary packaging services pre-market notice) and HOMEAFFAIRS/2216/RFI (Home Affairs aerial ISR uncrewed maritime capability). Tier 2 (Sydney Water, Melbourne Water, Transgrid, VendorPanel councils) and Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, EstimateOne, BHP/Rio/Fortescue-class buyers) were probed via search but returned only known portals or login-gated boards this run — no publicly-visible, verifiable, still-open corporate opportunity surfaced. Two genuinely new buyer-originated local-government sources were identified (Forbes Shire Council and Cumberland City Council).
gaps: EGRESS BLOCKED (organisation policy): all outbound WebFetch is denied with HTTP 403 EGRESS_BLOCKED by the agent egress proxy. Reconfirmed live this run against https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm. Per /root/.ccr/README.md this is a non-retryable organisation egress-policy denial, so NO tender detail page or specification/RFT document could be opened. Consequently every field below that is not derivable from a result-link <title> is SNIPPET-DERIVED and not independently verified, and full deliverables/requirements/documents extraction could not be performed for ANY entry — all 5 are counted in entries_pending_detail and should be re-verified once egress is restored.

Tier 1 state/territory portals (buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders): reachable only as search snippets; their live search/result pages and any RSS/API feeds could not be fetched. No NEW state/territory opportunity could be verified from a result-link title this run (search surfaced mostly already-known or already-closed notices with mid-September closing dates now past).

Tier 3 corporate e-sourcing (SAP Ariba / SAP Business Network Discovery, Coupa, Jaggaer, EstimateOne) and known major-buyer portals (BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside, Santos, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas, banks, telcos): probed via search but individual opportunities are login/registration-gated and no publicly-visible open RFx surfaced with a verifiable link. Portals remain recorded as sources (portal-registration); no corporate opportunity was fabricated.

HOMEAFFAIRS/2216/RFI: the AusTender result title appears as 'Current ATM View' (implying still open) but the WebSearch snippet reported a close date of 26-Aug-2026 (already past) and a publish date of 15-Jul-2026 — the snippet may have conflated this notice with an earlier Home Affairs RFI. Captured at headline level with the discrepancy flagged; closing date must be verified against the detail page once egress is restored.

DARLINGHURST NSW EOI (AusTender, JLL-managed property lease EOI) surfaced under BOTH a Current and a Closed ATM URL with a snippet closing date of '5.00pm AEDT Thursday, 2 February' — almost certainly an already-closed / historical property EOI. Excluded from tenders to avoid asserting an opportunity that is likely closed; noted here instead.

Aggregators seen as discovery signals only (NOT recorded as sources, per the buyer-originated rule): australiantenders.com.au, bidio.ai, tenderhub.com.au, govmarket.com.au, globaltenders.com, tendersinfo.com, bidsfactory.com. Used only to confirm a buyer/portal exists; buyer-originated sources were recorded instead.

tenders.title: Pre-RFT Notice — Deed of Agreement for Salary Packaging Services
tenders.description: Pre-market (Pre-RFT) notice advising industry that Defence intends to release a Request for Tender for a Deed of Agreement for Salary Packaging Services on AusTender in late-September 2026, establishing the arrangement with a single provider.
